intro: Welcome to Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition 2026. Below is the confirmed programming for the week in New York City – CryptoMondays, Tech Tuesdays (Liberland Meetup), the two-day Gallery MC main stage, BitcoinPalooza, the Washington Elite Investment Summit & Gala, and the International Day of Peace Concert – bringing together builders, policymakers, investors, and innovators at the intersection of blockchain, AI, climate tech, and real-world impact.

events.title: Multistakeholder Forum
events.description:
Leveraging Digital & Climate Tech to Advance the SDGs · United Nations Headquarters

We are involved in the planning, hosting and execution of this event with our partners. It is not included in any Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition tickets. Events at the UN cannot be sold for profit.

To apply for admittance (final decision by the UN): https://luma.com/SDG

events.title: CryptoMondays Wall Street
events.description: AI Security & Governance · GenAI, LLMs & the Future of FinTech · Wall Street
events.details: Confirmed CryptoMondays programming with panels on AI security, governance, and GenAI in FinTech. See the full timed agenda above.

events.title: Tech Tuesdays · Liberland Meetup
events.description: Liberty, Privacy & Ownership: From Liberland to the Ledger · Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St
events.details: Official Liberland Meetup evening under Tech Tuesdays, featuring the headline panel with Dorian Stern Vukotić, Bruce Porter Jr., Lou Kerner, and Randy Schwarz. See the full timed agenda above.

events.title: MAHA Wednesday
events.description: Special evening programming following Day 1 of the main conference · Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St
events.details: Continued discussions, networking, and curated sessions that build on the themes of the first conference day.

events.title: BitcoinPalooza
events.description: Official after party · Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St
events.details: Live performances, culture panels, fashion, and art – including Bella Porter, Alejandro Glatt, Emily Lazar, Aaron Williams, Enyo Sam, The Coinheads, and KOVO. See the full timed agenda above.

events.title: Washington Elite Investment Summit & Gala
events.description: Returning for the 4th year as the flagship event of Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition · Gallery MC
events.details: Washington Elite Investment Summit on the main stage, followed by the Gala. Opening performances by Santiago Cumplido Del Castillo; Brock Pierce opens the summit. See the full timed agenda above.

events.title: Pause the World for Peace
events.description: 24th Annual LIVE CLEAN ENERGY International Day of Peace Concert · Times Square
events.details: In collaboration with PaulSladkus. A special daytime concert celebrating peace and clean energy, closing out Blockchain Week – UNGA Edition in the heart of Times Square.

conference.title: Flagship Conference · September 16–17
conference.summary: Two full days on the Gallery MC main stage – from opening keynotes with President Vít Jedlička and Brock Pierce through policy, AI, stablecoins, RWAs, and the hand-off to BitcoinPalooza.

days.label: Day 1 – Wednesday, September 16 · 9am–5pm
days.focusAreas: Sovereignty, rules, and the trust layer – liberty & privacy, constitutional internet, AI agents, on-chain risk, and closing with energy & health sovereignty.
days.description: Main Stage · Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St, New York, NY 10019. Full timed agenda above.

days.label: Day 2 – Thursday, September 17 · 9am–5pm
days.focusAreas: Capital, the global dollar, and real-world assets – Bitcoin, stablecoin corridors, investor pitching, provenance, tokenization, and real estate on-chain.
days.description: Main Stage · Gallery MC, 549 W 52nd St, New York, NY 10019, then BitcoinPalooza from 7pm. Full timed agenda above.
